headline: AI-driven growth lifts most majors, but revenue pace varies widely.
summary: TCS and HCLTech posted solid top‑line growth and strong operating margins, helped by expanding AI revenue. Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance as revenue growth slowed to low single digits. Smaller players such as Coforge delivered exceptional YoY growth, while profit margins were mixed across the cohort.

themes.title: AI as a revenue catalyst
themes.detail: AI revenue grew double‑digit YoY for several firms, boosting deal wins and margins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, reflecting uncertainty in macro demand.

leaders.why: YoY revenue growth of 66.6% and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance was cut.
